name: Iris
source:
The head of the high elves who lives from the age of old myths and is considered a Goddess. 
With extreme magical abilities, she is a being that transcends all creatures, a guardian of the forest. 
Usually, She lives away from her fellow elves and she is living in the sacred God Tree. 
She is like a hermit, because she's lived for so long, sleep and food are almost unnecessary. A calm and collected character. 
Like all Elves she is also a virgin but curiously she has the most libido out of the elves.
